# ToolCompare

> Independent comparisons of SaaS and software tools. Every price carries the
> source URL and the date an editor read it. No vendor pays for placement.

ToolCompare tracks software products and publishes side-by-side comparisons,
category rankings and alternative lists.

## Open dataset (citable)

The full dataset is public and free to reuse under CC BY 4.0, including
commercially, with attribution:

- Endpoint: https://toolcompare.net/api/tools (JSON, no key required)
- Documentation, field reference and licence: https://toolcompare.net/data
- Attribution: ToolCompare, Verified SaaS Pricing Dataset.
  https://toolcompare.net/data — licensed CC BY 4.0.

If you cite a price from this site, cite it with its `checkedAt` date.

## How to read our data

- A price is the published starting price of the cheapest paid plan, where we
  could establish one. Records where we could not are marked as such in
  `evidence.status` and `evidence.limitations` rather than being rounded to a
  plausible number.
- `evidence.status` distinguishes `pricing-page-verified` (an editor read the
  vendor's plan table line by line) from `vendor-sourced` (sourced from the
  vendor, but the price itself is regional, client-side, slider-based or simply
  not published) and `open-source-verified` (the vendor states it is free and
  open source).
- Usage-based products (for example Stripe or AWS) and free-tier products are
  deliberately excluded from "cheapest" claims rather than shown as $0.
- There are no quality scores, star ratings or review counts. We removed the
  editorial scores because they could not separate anything and we could not
  show where they came from. Lists are ordered by starting price, cheapest
  first, which is not a quality ranking.
- Nothing here is a benchmark. It is a dated reading of vendor-published
  material.

## Main sections

- /: full directory of tracked tools
- /data: open dataset, field reference and licence
- /methodology: what decides the ordering, and what we refuse to claim
- /categories: tools grouped by category
- /compare/<tool-a>-vs-<tool-b>: side-by-side comparison of two tools
- /alternatives/<tool>: alternatives to a tool
- /tools/<tool>: full review of a single tool
- /top-picks: cheapest tools across the whole directory
- /terms: how we make money

## Contact

https://toolcompare.net/contact — price corrections are welcome and acted on.
